description: This file defines functions for managing enterprise key parameters, including adding team member key durations and organization IDs to key request data. It interacts with type definitions and team metadata, indicating it's part of key management logic within a larger system.

methods.name: GenerateKeyRequest add_team_member_key_duration( team_table: Optional[LiteLLM_TeamTable], data: GenerateKeyRequest, )
methods.description: Adds team member key duration to the GenerateKeyRequest if applicable based on team table metadata.

methods.name: GenerateKeyRequest add_team_organization_id( team_table: Optional[LiteLLM_TeamTable], data: GenerateKeyRequest, )
methods.description: Sets the organization ID in GenerateKeyRequest based on the team table's organization ID.

methods.name: GenerateKeyRequest apply_enterprise_key_management_params( data: GenerateKeyRequest, team_table: Optional[LiteLLM_TeamTable], )
methods.description: Applies enterprise key management parameters by augmenting the GenerateKeyRequest with team-specific data.
